# Review one exact task specification

Return one JSON object with status, summary, and target_id.
Review the supplied tree independently of the planner's confidence.
When active_recovery is present, require a prerequisite-ready recovery specialist leaf with observable safety acceptance.
Recovery takes priority over optional work. Its needed tree changes can supersede an earlier optional refinement scope.
Recovery criteria describe the finished safe landing; they need not hold before ordinary escape or clearance actions.
If a placed workstation obstructs that landing, a different surveyed landing or ordinary block removal can establish safety.
Use revise for an incorrect recovery predicate that ordinary survival actions can repair. Reserve blocked for an actual external blocker.
The actor guard independently requires two safe observations and fresh supported dry geometry before recovery completion.
Recovery leaf criteria can use the supported alive, position, and exact block primitives; do not request an unsupported dynamic predicate.
Require acceptance conditions that cover the actual requested goal.
Read condition kinds and operands, rather than trusting their descriptions.
A block condition checks one cell or every listed position. It does not use end or a count threshold.
Root criteria must establish the finished outcome, including required usability facts.
Require accepted references for earlier achievements whose world facts no longer hold after dependent work.
Do not combine consumed inventory thresholds or different entry and exit positions as simultaneous final facts.
An accepted reference cites a descendant or prerequisite node with independent world evidence, never an actor claim.
References remain valid when a prerequisite leaf becomes a story with the same original criteria.
The runtime verifies that story after its children, before releasing dependent work that consumes its materials.
Require prerequisite success before dependent execution.
The runtime has validated hierarchy, dependency identities, and cycles before this review.
leaf_prerequisites gives the resolved graph, including story and ancestor dependencies. Read its actual edges before claiming a missing prerequisite.
Criteria describe future outcomes. Their prerequisites do not need to be accepted before initial plan review.
The selector requires their independent certificates before dependent dispatch.
project_initial_observation supplies the original inventory baseline. original_observation supplies current retained world state.
An inventory threshold of twenty from an empty baseline satisfies twenty additional items at that leaf's verification time.
Accepted inventory attainment does not require the collected items to remain after crafting consumes them.
current_site_survey.recipes contains original recipe lookups with ingredient counts and output_count.
Use these counts for arithmetic. Do not invent a crafting ratio or infer a resource shortfall from an empty starting inventory before gathering.
Require observable usability conditions when the goal asks for a usable structure.
Check entry and exit coordinates against the actual floor and wall bounds.
A house entry belongs inside the clear interior; its exit belongs outside the outer footprint beside the door approach.
An interior corner cannot establish exit, regardless of its description.
Reject invented resource observations or unsupported starting assumptions.
Nearby-block summaries can include buried ore. An empty exposed-region result or an inspection with no exposed_faces cannot establish exposed ore.
When the location is unknown, a feasible exposed-search method can precede mining; a guessed confirmed ore location cannot.
The current_site_survey contains original read-only inspections of proposed physical cells and regions.
Read those facts before requesting terrain information. Future construction conditions normally do not hold yet.
Exact cell inspections establish the named cells. A nearby-block summary cannot prove that a surveyed structure is absent.
Evaluate observed names against the condition's allowed names. Dirt can satisfy a solid-foundation condition that permits dirt.
An existing correct structure can be retained, repaired, and independently verified in a new task.
Do not require it to be built again from an empty world.
Respect a requested site and its explicit distance bound. Do not invent a tighter location constraint.
Use the named starting point for that bound. A body's later movement does not move the requested site.
An explicit preparation leaf can establish them before dependent building work.
Do not ask the operator for a grid already present in these observations.
For incorrect criteria, missing acceptance coverage, or unsupported assumptions, return revise.
Revision can repair acceptance conditions. Refinement preserves them while splitting oversized work.
When a leaf combines separate gathering, crafting, construction, and usability outcomes, request refinement of that leaf.
Tool-call count alone does not make a leaf oversized.
Select one target_id for controlled refinement.
Accept a tree whose leaves express meaningful outcomes and whose criteria cover the request.
When information is missing, return waiting with a precise question.
When a real blocker prevents a feasible plan, return blocked.

tool_contracts.name: minecraft_eat_best
tool_contracts.description:
Eat the best food you carry: most hunger restored, least waste.

Picks from your inventory automatically - no equipping needed.
`considered` lists the foods that were evaluated, so you also learn
your options.

Failure modes:
    - reason "no_food": nothing edible in your inventory.
    - reason "food_full": hunger already maxed (nothing consumed).

See also: minecraft_use_item

tool_contracts.name: minecraft_recipe_search
tool_contracts.description:
Search the recipe book by glob - the catalogue of everything craftable.

THE planning tool for crafting. Ask it what exists ("*pickaxe"), what
you can afford RIGHT NOW (craftable_now=true), or what a specific item
costs ("bed", "furnace"). Every entry includes the full ingredient list
with have/missing counts, so you know exactly what to gather before
you even try to craft.

The result contains at most 32 recipes.

Each item entry shows one concrete ingredient variant. It selects
available ingredients, or the smallest current ingredient deficit.
If you own logs but need planks, search "*_planks" with
craftable_now=True and craft that available plank recipe first.
Then search the required item again with the new inventory.

pattern.description:
Glob on the crafted item's name. Default "*" matches the
whole recipe book.

craftable_now.description:
None (default) = report all matches regardless of
inventory. True = only recipes you can craft right now (also
checks crafting-table presence for 3x3 recipes). False = only
recipes you currently CANNOT craft (shopping list).

tool_contracts.name: minecraft_smelt_item
tool_contracts.description:
Smelt items in a nearby furnace, fully automatic.

Finds a furnace within 8 blocks, clears stale
slots, loads input and fuel, waits for the smelt, and returns the output
to your inventory. The distance includes its boundary. It uses distance
from your feet to the furnace block-cell position. The whole trip is one
call.

input.description: Item name or glob to smelt, e.g. "raw_iron", "*raw_iron".

fuel.description:
Fuel name or glob, default None = auto-pick best available
(coal/charcoal > planks > logs > sticks).

fuel_count.description: Fuel items to burn, default 1. One coal smelts 8 items.

messages.content:
# Plan a retained world

Turn the requested goal into a generic goal/story/leaf task tree.
Use the supplied schema exactly. Return one JSON object.
Use compact JSON. Omit optional fields that use their default values.
For initial planning, provide tree. With previous_tree, prefer updates containing only the complete nodes you intentionally change or add.
Omitted nodes stay unchanged. Do not copy unrelated nodes into updates. Never provide both tree and updates.
Node updates still need their full retained conditions, parent, dependencies, and specialist; omitted node fields take schema defaults.
When refinement_target is supplied, use the refinement schema: replacement is that complete node under its same ID and parent.
Copy its original criteria exactly. additions contains only new descendants beneath replacement.
Leave home, entry, exit, and all other existing unrelated nodes omitted. Do not return tree or updates for this schema.
Group exact cells with identical accepted names in one block condition's positions list.
For a block condition, omit end and minimum. Every listed position must match.
For an inventory or region condition, minimum is a count threshold.
For a food condition, minimum is observed food on its 0..20 scale. Low-supplies recovery requires at least 7.
An alive condition checks only health greater than zero; it cannot establish food recovery.
Only a region condition accepts end. It measures a visible histogram, not individual hidden cells.
Use stable short IDs. Runtime code assigns revision counters.
Only the root goal has parent=null. Set every other node's parent to its containing goal or story ID.
List each child in that parent's children. Parent and child references must agree.
Keep specifications separate from attempts and observed effects.
A leaf describes one meaningful outcome. It can require many tool calls.
Use gathering, crafting, construction, and usability prerequisites when the requested outcome requires them.
Do not limit goals to a fixed catalog.
Choose explicit, feasible acceptance conditions from the observation primitives.
Inventory names accept globs. Block names use exact Minecraft identifiers.
Use actual world coordinates. Do not invent a surveyed building site.
Condition positions use the schema's integer operands. Position distance is measured from floating feet coordinates; preserve the requested radius bounds.
For a house, the entry target belongs inside its clear interior. The exit target must lie outside its outer footprint, by the door approach.
Nearby-block summaries can include buried cells. They do not establish exposed ore.
Locate ore through exposed-cell find_block results and exact inspections with nonempty exposed_faces.
Do not probe buried ore coordinates from a nearby-block summary. Exact foundation inspections still describe ordinary construction support.
When ore coordinates remain unknown, plan an ordinary exposed search within the mining outcome instead of inventing a confirmed location.
Preserve the requested site and explicit distance bound when the body moves.
Exact cell reads establish existing construction. Retain correct blocks instead of repeating completed physical work.
The repaired body can dig grass and tall_grass. is_solid describes collision bounds; it does not restrict digging to solid cubes.
For preparation before block placement, allow observed replaceable vegetation when placement will remove it, or request ordinary plant digging.
Keep final required air cells strict after construction. Require fresh block evidence after vegetation clearance.
project_initial_observation is the original project baseline. observation is current state after retained world effects.
For an unchanged request, keep relative inventory targets based on the original baseline. Do not add the requested increment again after each failed attempt.
When the user changes instructions, use the new wording and current state to define the revised outcome.
Use a navigation survey leaf before construction when the current site is unsuitable.
Use previous_site_survey when supplied. Its retained cells describe the earlier surveyed site, not current completion.
Use latest_verification for failed acceptance. It identifies the original actor and verifier, exact operands, checks, and observed reads.
A region predicate measures blocks currently visible in that volume. It does not establish where earlier harvesting occurred.
Do not require harvested logs to remain as world blocks after gathering them into inventory.
Describe all usability requirements with observable criteria, including access, interior clearance, walls, and roof when requested.
Root criteria must cover the complete finished structure, rather than only a roof or one corner.
An installed Minecraft door occupies both its lower and upper cells. Both cells contain the door block, not air.
The region tool excludes hidden cells. Prefer exact block conditions for enclosed structures.
Acceptance records past attainment. Use assumptions for facts that must remain true.
Do not require gathered materials to remain in inventory after a dependent crafting task consumes them.
Use kind=accepted with node_id to cite independently verified earlier work in aggregate criteria.
For goals and stories, cite a verified descendant or declared prerequisite node. For leaves, cite a node whose leaves are explicitly declared prerequisites.
Declare each cited prerequisite directly in the leaf's depends_on. A dependency of another dependency does not authorize that certificate reference.
References remain valid when a prerequisite leaf becomes a story. Its original criteria stay on that story.
The selector verifies a completed story before dependent work can consume its materials.
For a material story, cite accepted gathering and crafting leaves rather than requiring consumed stock to remain.
For entry and exit, cite both accepted leaves in aggregate criteria. The body cannot finish at both positions simultaneously.
Keep fresh block criteria for the finished structure. Accepted references do not establish current inventory or current position.
Preserve stable IDs and all useful completed work during replanning.
Use gameplay_history for accumulated failed methods, partial quantities, search coverage, and active recovery.
For pm.gameplay-planning.v2, each methods row follows method_fields in order.
Its state_index selects complete preconditions in method_states.
Its last row follows outcome_fields; merge additional_fields for changed result operands.
Resolve each journal source_index through source_paths.
Resolve each outcome kind_index through outcome_kinds.
Search entries inherit search_defaults; explicit entry values override them.
The row's tool and arguments also identify its last outcome unless additional_fields overrides them.
Historical inventory retains canonical names, counts, and available tool metadata. Display labels and empty fields remain in original journals.
Its last outcome uses that method's tool and arguments unless it records changed operands, such as a result limit.
Original journals retain the complete records.
rejected_proposal contains only changed nodes and removed IDs, with its original receipt reference.
An unchanged rejected condition uses from_node and condition_id to refer to its exact definition in previous_tree.
Keep every stable node ID. To split a leaf, make it a story under that same ID and add children beneath it.
Invalid raw output supplies an error excerpt rather than changed_nodes. Rebuild valid JSON from previous_tree and the requested change.
Active recovery can supersede optional scope when no recovery leaf is ready. Once a recovery leaf is ready, honor the supplied refinement_target.
Retain a ready recovery leaf while splitting the named optional target. Do not repeat accepted material work.
Use latest_plan_review to repair the last reviewed specification, including an earlier blocked review retained across explicit resume.
Recovery criteria describe a safe finished landing. Choose a surveyed dry alternative or include ordinary clearance of an observed removable obstruction.
Do not assume the current head cell is air when an exact inspection shows a placed workstation there.
Each search records only loaded, exposed cells in its dimension and coverage at its observation time.
Do not infer world-wide absence from an empty local search.
After two ineffective attempts, use a targeted diagnosis and a concrete changed method.
Replanning must add, revise, or defer a concrete leaf. Better wording outside the tree cannot release another attempt.
For a deferred leaf, set deferred=true and give a defer_reason. Its effects remain; it cannot pass final acceptance while deferred.
When recovery is active, add or revise a prerequisite-ready recovery specialist leaf before optional work.
Recovery needs full air, stable health, sufficient food, and exact dry landing geometry. A movement success alone cannot end it.
Keep recovery active through another method when the first escape fails.
Preserve original inventory targets and accepted work after partial progress.
Copy unchanged specifications exactly, including wording, criteria order, and assumptions.
Do not paraphrase accepted nodes. Change them only when the revised request or original evidence requires it.
When rejected_proposal is supplied, repair the stated contract error before submitting that proposal again.
When refinement names a target, change only that node and its descendants.
Preserve its original acceptance conditions exactly.
Split an oversized leaf into a story with prerequisite-ordered child outcomes.
Do not reuse Git rollback assumptions. All world effects remain.
When world facts are missing, return survey with explicit queries using the condition operands.
Use block queries for exact terrain layers or clearance cells. Inventory, position, alive, food, and region queries are also available.
Survey thresholds do not accept work. Use requested_world_survey as retained planning evidence.
Request world reads instead of asking the user to inspect terrain that MCP can read.
When an external service or a user preference is missing, return waiting with the specific question.
When the goal is impossible, return blocked with the actual reason.

Do not ask the operator for recipe evidence that the configured read-only tools can obtain.
current_tool_contracts gives fresh recipe-search and smelting schemas, even when the retained survey predates them.
Crafting recipes do not describe furnace smelting. Use actual smelt input/output evidence for the iron chain.
When recovery is active, first repair the ready recovery leaf with truthful food and safety conditions. Preserve completed material work.
Use compact JSON. Omit optional fields that use their default values.
For initial planning, provide tree. With previous_tree, prefer updates containing only the complete nodes you intentionally change or add.
Omitted nodes stay unchanged. Do not copy unrelated nodes into updates. Never provide both tree and updates.
Node updates still need their full retained conditions, parent, dependencies, and specialist; omitted node fields take schema defaults.
When refinement_target is supplied, use the refinement schema: replacement is that complete node under its same ID and parent.
Copy its original criteria exactly. additions contains only new descendants beneath replacement.
Leave home, entry, exit, and all other existing unrelated nodes omitted. Do not return tree or updates for this schema.
Group exact cells with identical accepted names in one block condition's positions list.
For a block condition, omit end and minimum. Every listed position must match.
For an inventory or region condition, minimum is a count threshold.
For a food condition, minimum is observed food on its 0..20 scale. Low-supplies recovery requires at least 7.
An alive condition checks only health greater than zero; it cannot establish food recovery.
Only a region condition accepts end. It measures a visible histogram, not individual hidden cells.
Use stable short IDs. Runtime code assigns revision counters.
Only the root goal has parent=null. Set every other node's parent to its containing goal or story ID.
List each child in that parent's children. Parent and child references must agree.
Keep specifications separate from attempts and observed effects.
A leaf describes one meaningful outcome. It can require many tool calls.
Use gathering, crafting, construction, and usability prerequisites when the requested outcome requires them.
Do not limit goals to a fixed catalog.
Choose explicit, feasible acceptance conditions from the observation primitives.
Inventory names accept globs. Block names use exact Minecraft identifiers.
Use actual world coordinates. Do not invent a surveyed building site.
Condition positions use the schema's integer operands. Position distance is measured from floating feet coordinates; preserve the requested radius bounds.
For a house, the entry target belongs inside its clear interior. The exit target must lie outside its outer footprint, by the door approach.
Nearby-block summaries can include buried cells. They do not establish exposed ore.
Locate ore through exposed-cell find_block results and exact inspections with nonempty exposed_faces.
Do not probe buried ore coordinates from a nearby-block summary. Exact foundation inspections still describe ordinary construction support.
When ore coordinates remain unknown, plan an ordinary exposed search within the mining outcome instead of inventing a confirmed location.
Preserve the requested site and explicit distance bound when the body moves.
Exact cell reads establish existing construction. Retain correct blocks instead of repeating completed physical work.
The repaired body can dig grass and tall_grass. is_solid describes collision bounds; it does not restrict digging to solid cubes.
For preparation before block placement, allow observed replaceable vegetation when placement will remove it, or request ordinary plant digging.
Keep final required air cells strict after construction. Require fresh block evidence after vegetation clearance.
project_initial_observation is the original project baseline. observation is current state after retained world effects.
For an unchanged request, keep relative inventory targets based on the original baseline. Do not add the requested increment again after each failed attempt.
When the user changes instructions, use the new wording and current state to define the revised outcome.
Use a navigation survey leaf before construction when the current site is unsuitable.
Use previous_site_survey when supplied. Its retained cells describe the earlier surveyed site, not current completion.
Use latest_verification for failed acceptance. It identifies the original actor and verifier, exact operands, checks, and observed reads.
A region predicate measures blocks currently visible in that volume. It does not establish where earlier harvesting occurred.
Do not require harvested logs to remain as world blocks after gathering them into inventory.
Describe all usability requirements with observable criteria, including access, interior clearance, walls, and roof when requested.
Root criteria must cover the complete finished structure, rather than only a roof or one corner.
An installed Minecraft door occupies both its lower and upper cells. Both cells contain the door block, not air.
The region tool excludes hidden cells. Prefer exact block conditions for enclosed structures.
Acceptance records past attainment. Use assumptions for facts that must remain true.
Do not require gathered materials to remain in inventory after a dependent crafting task consumes them.
Use kind=accepted with node_id to cite independently verified earlier work in aggregate criteria.
For goals and stories, cite a verified descendant or declared prerequisite node. For leaves, cite a node whose leaves are explicitly declared prerequisites.
Declare each cited prerequisite directly in the leaf's depends_on. A dependency of another dependency does not authorize that certificate reference.
References remain valid when a prerequisite leaf becomes a story. Its original criteria stay on that story.
The selector verifies a completed story before dependent work can consume its materials.
For a material story, cite accepted gathering and crafting leaves rather than requiring consumed stock to remain.
For entry and exit, cite both accepted leaves in aggregate criteria. The body cannot finish at both positions simultaneously.
Keep fresh block criteria for the finished structure. Accepted references do not establish current inventory or current position.
Preserve stable IDs and all useful completed work during replanning.
Use gameplay_history for accumulated failed methods, partial quantities, search coverage, and active recovery.
For pm.gameplay-planning.v2, each methods row follows method_fields in order.
Its state_index selects complete preconditions in method_states.
Its last row follows outcome_fields; merge additional_fields for changed result operands.
Resolve each journal source_index through source_paths.
Resolve each outcome kind_index through outcome_kinds.
Search entries inherit search_defaults; explicit entry values override them.
The row's tool and arguments also identify its last outcome unless additional_fields overrides them.
Historical inventory retains canonical names, counts, and available tool metadata. Display labels and empty fields remain in original journals.
Its last outcome uses that method's tool and arguments unless it records changed operands, such as a result limit.
Original journals retain the complete records.
rejected_proposal contains only changed nodes and removed IDs, with its original receipt reference.
An unchanged rejected condition uses from_node and condition_id to refer to its exact definition in previous_tree.
Keep every stable node ID. To split a leaf, make it a story under that same ID and add children beneath it.
Invalid raw output supplies an error excerpt rather than changed_nodes. Rebuild valid JSON from previous_tree and the requested change.
Active recovery can supersede optional scope when no recovery leaf is ready. Once a recovery leaf is ready, honor the supplied refinement_target.
Retain a ready recovery leaf while splitting the named optional target. Do not repeat accepted material work.
Use latest_plan_review to repair the last reviewed specification, including an earlier blocked review retained across explicit resume.
Recovery criteria describe a safe finished landing. Choose a surveyed dry alternative or include ordinary clearance of an observed removable obstruction.
Do not assume the current head cell is air when an exact inspection shows a placed workstation there.
Each search records only loaded, exposed cells in its dimension and coverage at its observation time.
Do not infer world-wide absence from an empty local search.
After two ineffective attempts, use a targeted diagnosis and a concrete changed method.
Replanning must add, revise, or defer a concrete leaf. Better wording outside the tree cannot release another attempt.
For a deferred leaf, set deferred=true and give a defer_reason. Its effects remain; it cannot pass final acceptance while deferred.
When recovery is active, add or revise a prerequisite-ready recovery specialist leaf before optional work.
Recovery needs full air, stable health, sufficient food, and exact dry landing geometry. A movement success alone cannot end it.
Keep recovery active through another method when the first escape fails.
Preserve original inventory targets and accepted work after partial progress.
Copy unchanged specifications exactly, including wording, criteria order, and assumptions.
Do not paraphrase accepted nodes. Change them only when the revised request or original evidence requires it.
When rejected_proposal is supplied, repair the stated contract error before submitting that proposal again.
When refinement names a target, change only that node and its descendants.
Preserve its original acceptance conditions exactly.
Split an oversized leaf into a story with prerequisite-ordered child outcomes.
Do not reuse Git rollback assumptions. All world effects remain.
When world facts are missing, return survey with explicit queries using the condition operands.
Use block queries for exact terrain layers or clearance cells. Inventory, position, alive, food, and region queries are also available.
Survey thresholds do not accept work. Use requested_world_survey as retained planning evidence.
Request world reads instead of asking the user to inspect terrain that MCP can read.
When an external service or a user preference is missing, return waiting with the specific question.
When the goal is impossible, return blocked with the actual reason.

# Plan a retained world

Turn the requested goal into a generic goal/story/leaf task tree.
Use the supplied schema exactly. Return one JSON object.
Retained feedback and reviews can contain incorrect interpretations. Check their claims against original reads and the current tool contracts.
Current inventory is a starting state, not a permanent resource limit. Missing planks or cobblestone require counted gathering or crafting, not blocked.
Use the wood actually gathered. Repair unaccepted exact wood names to that variant when the goal permits a wooden structure.
If a requested recipe name has no match, request survey with recipe_queries for a likely exact variant, such as ["birch_door"] when birch wood was gathered.
Do not ask the operator for recipe evidence that the configured read-only tools can obtain.
current_tool_contracts gives fresh recipe-search and smelting schemas, even when the retained survey predates them.
Crafting recipes do not describe furnace smelting. Use actual smelt input/output evidence for the iron chain.
When recovery is active, first repair the ready recovery leaf with truthful food and safety conditions. Preserve completed material work.
Use compact JSON. Omit optional fields that use their default values.
For initial planning, provide tree. With previous_tree, prefer updates containing only the complete nodes you intentionally change or add.
Omitted nodes stay unchanged. Do not copy unrelated nodes into updates. Never provide both tree and updates.
Node updates still need their full retained conditions, parent, dependencies, and specialist; omitted node fields take schema defaults.
When refinement_target is supplied, use the refinement schema: replacement is that complete node under its same ID and parent.
Copy its original criteria exactly. additions contains only new descendants beneath replacement.
Leave home, entry, exit, and all other existing unrelated nodes omitted. Do not return tree or updates for this schema.
Group exact cells with identical accepted names in one block condition's positions list.
For a block condition, omit end and minimum. Every listed position must match.
For an inventory or region condition, minimum is a count threshold.
For a food condition, minimum is observed food on its 0..20 scale. Low-supplies recovery requires at least 7.
An alive condition checks only health greater than zero; it cannot establish food recovery.
Only a region condition accepts end. It measures a visible histogram, not individual hidden cells.
Use stable short IDs. Runtime code assigns revision counters.
Only the root goal has parent=null. Set every other node's parent to its containing goal or story ID.
List each child in that parent's children. Parent and child references must agree.
Keep specifications separate from attempts and observed effects.
A leaf describes one meaningful outcome. It can require many tool calls.
Use gathering, crafting, construction, and usability prerequisites when the requested outcome requires them.
Do not limit goals to a fixed catalog.
Choose explicit, feasible acceptance conditions from the observation primitives.
Inventory names accept globs. Block names use exact Minecraft identifiers.
Use actual world coordinates. Do not invent a surveyed building site.
Condition positions use the schema's integer operands. Position distance is measured from floating feet coordinates; preserve the requested radius bounds.
For a house, the entry target belongs inside its clear interior. The exit target must lie outside its outer footprint, by the door approach.
Nearby-block summaries can include buried cells. They do not establish exposed ore.
Locate ore through exposed-cell find_block results and exact inspections with nonempty exposed_faces.
Do not probe buried ore coordinates from a nearby-block summary. Exact foundation inspections still describe ordinary construction support.
When ore coordinates remain unknown, plan an ordinary exposed search within the mining outcome instead of inventing a confirmed location.
Preserve the requested site and explicit distance bound when the body moves.
Exact cell reads establish existing construction. Retain correct blocks instead of repeating completed physical work.
The repaired body can dig grass and tall_grass. is_solid describes collision bounds; it does not restrict digging to solid cubes.
For preparation before block placement, allow observed replaceable vegetation when placement will remove it, or request ordinary plant digging.
Keep final required air cells strict after construction. Require fresh block evidence after vegetation clearance.
project_initial_observation is the original project baseline. observation is current state after retained world effects.
For an unchanged request, keep relative inventory targets based on the original baseline. Do not add the requested increment again after each failed attempt.
When the user changes instructions, use the new wording and current state to define the revised outcome.
Use a navigation survey leaf before construction when the current site is unsuitable.
Use previous_site_survey when supplied. Its retained cells describe the earlier surveyed site, not current completion.
Use latest_verification for failed acceptance. It identifies the original actor and verifier, exact operands, checks, and observed reads.
A region predicate measures blocks currently visible in that volume. It does not establish where earlier harvesting occurred.
Do not require harvested logs to remain as world blocks after gathering them into inventory.
Describe all usability requirements with observable criteria, including access, interior clearance, walls, and roof when requested.
Root criteria must cover the complete finished structure, rather than only a roof or one corner.
An installed Minecraft door occupies both its lower and upper cells. Both cells contain the door block, not air.
The region tool excludes hidden cells. Prefer exact block conditions for enclosed structures.
Acceptance records past attainment. Use assumptions for facts that must remain true.
Do not require gathered materials to remain in inventory after a dependent crafting task consumes them.
Use kind=accepted with node_id to cite independently verified earlier work in aggregate criteria.
For goals and stories, cite a verified descendant or declared prerequisite node. For leaves, cite a node whose leaves are explicitly declared prerequisites.
Declare each cited prerequisite directly in the leaf's depends_on. A dependency of another dependency does not authorize that certificate reference.
References remain valid when a prerequisite leaf becomes a story. Its original criteria stay on that story.
The selector verifies a completed story before dependent work can consume its materials.
For a material story, cite accepted gathering and crafting leaves rather than requiring consumed stock to remain.
For entry and exit, cite both accepted leaves in aggregate criteria. The body cannot finish at both positions simultaneously.
Keep fresh block criteria for the finished structure. Accepted references do not establish current inventory or current position.
Preserve stable IDs and all useful completed work during replanning.
Use gameplay_history for accumulated failed methods, partial quantities, search coverage, and active recovery.
For pm.gameplay-planning.v2, each methods row follows method_fields in order.
Its state_index selects complete preconditions in method_states.
Its last row follows outcome_fields; merge additional_fields for changed result operands.
Resolve each journal source_index through source_paths.
Resolve each outcome kind_index through outcome_kinds.
Search entries inherit search_defaults; explicit entry values override them.
The row's tool and arguments also identify its last outcome unless additional_fields overrides them.
Historical inventory retains canonical names, counts, and available tool metadata. Display labels and empty fields remain in original journals.
Its last outcome uses that method's tool and arguments unless it records changed operands, such as a result limit.
Original journals retain the complete records.
rejected_proposal contains only changed nodes and removed IDs, with its original receipt reference.
An unchanged rejected condition uses from_node and condition_id to refer to its exact definition in previous_tree.
Keep every stable node ID. To split a leaf, make it a story under that same ID and add children beneath it.
Invalid raw output supplies an error excerpt rather than changed_nodes. Rebuild valid JSON from previous_tree and the requested change.
Active recovery can supersede optional scope when no recovery leaf is ready. Once a recovery leaf is ready, honor the supplied refinement_target.
Retain a ready recovery leaf while splitting the named optional target. Do not repeat accepted material work.
Use latest_plan_review to repair the last reviewed specification, including an earlier blocked review retained across explicit resume.
Recovery criteria describe a safe finished landing. Choose a surveyed dry alternative or include ordinary clearance of an observed removable obstruction.
Do not assume the current head cell is air when an exact inspection shows a placed workstation there.
Each search records only loaded, exposed cells in its dimension and coverage at its observation time.
Do not infer world-wide absence from an empty local search.
After two ineffective attempts, use a targeted diagnosis and a concrete changed method.
Replanning must add, revise, or defer a concrete leaf. Better wording outside the tree cannot release another attempt.
For a deferred leaf, set deferred=true and give a defer_reason. Its effects remain; it cannot pass final acceptance while deferred.
When recovery is active, add or revise a prerequisite-ready recovery specialist leaf before optional work.
Recovery needs full air, stable health, sufficient food, and exact dry landing geometry. A movement success alone cannot end it.
Keep recovery active through another method when the first escape fails.
Preserve original inventory targets and accepted work after partial progress.
Copy unchanged specifications exactly, including wording, criteria order, and assumptions.
Do not paraphrase accepted nodes. Change them only when the revised request or original evidence requires it.
When rejected_proposal is supplied, repair the stated contract error before submitting that proposal again.
When refinement names a target, change only that node and its descendants.
Preserve its original acceptance conditions exactly.
Split an oversized leaf into a story with prerequisite-ordered child outcomes.
Do not reuse Git rollback assumptions. All world effects remain.
When world facts are missing, return survey with explicit queries using the condition operands.
Use block queries for exact terrain layers or clearance cells. Inventory, position, alive, food, and region queries are also available.
Survey thresholds do not accept work. Use requested_world_survey as retained planning evidence.
Request world reads instead of asking the user to inspect terrain that MCP can read.
When an external service or a user preference is missing, return waiting with the specific question.
When the goal is impossible, return blocked with the actual reason.

review.summary: The recovery criteria incorrectly identify the body position in the r_recover_final leaf using 'kind': 'alive' for the food check instead of 'kind': 'food'. While the description says 'food points', the kind 'alive' only checks health > 0. The body already has 18 health, so the current condition is trivially true and does not enforce the required recovery target of restoring food to a safe level. Additionally, the r_recover_final leaf must ensure the body is alive and the food level is at least 6 (or 7 per low_supplies guidelines) to satisfy the recovery criteria. The food condition should use 'kind': 'food' with an appropriate minimum value to enforce the safe landing state described in the instruction.

messages.content:
# Plan a retained world

Turn the requested goal into a generic goal/story/leaf task tree.
Use the supplied schema exactly. Return one JSON object.
Retained feedback and reviews can contain incorrect interpretations. Check their claims against original reads and the current tool contracts.
Current inventory is a starting state, not a permanent resource limit. Missing planks or cobblestone require counted gathering or crafting, not blocked.
Use the wood actually gathered. Repair unaccepted exact wood names to that variant when the goal permits a wooden structure.
If a requested recipe name has no match, request survey with recipe_queries for a likely exact variant, such as ["birch_door"] when birch wood was gathered.
Do not ask the operator for recipe evidence that the configured read-only tools can obtain.
current_tool_contracts gives fresh recipe-search and smelting schemas, even when the retained survey predates them.
Crafting recipes do not describe furnace smelting. Use actual smelt input/output evidence for the iron chain.
When recovery is active, first repair the ready recovery leaf with truthful food and safety conditions. Preserve completed material work.
Use compact JSON. Omit optional fields that use their default values.
For initial planning, provide tree. With previous_tree, prefer updates containing only the complete nodes you intentionally change or add.
Omitted nodes stay unchanged. Do not copy unrelated nodes into updates. Never provide both tree and updates.
Node updates still need their full retained conditions, parent, dependencies, and specialist; omitted node fields take schema defaults.
When refinement_target is supplied, use the refinement schema: replacement is that complete node under its same ID and parent.
Copy its original criteria exactly. additions contains only new descendants beneath replacement.
Leave home, entry, exit, and all other existing unrelated nodes omitted. Do not return tree or updates for this schema.
Group exact cells with identical accepted names in one block condition's positions list.
For a block condition, omit end and minimum. Every listed position must match.
For an inventory or region condition, minimum is a count threshold.
For a food condition, minimum is observed food on its 0..20 scale. Low-supplies recovery requires at least 7.
An alive condition checks only health greater than zero; it cannot establish food recovery.
Only a region condition accepts end. It measures a visible histogram, not individual hidden cells.
Use stable short IDs. Runtime code assigns revision counters.
Only the root goal has parent=null. Set every other node's parent to its containing goal or story ID.
List each child in that parent's children. Parent and child references must agree.
Keep specifications separate from attempts and observed effects.
A leaf describes one meaningful outcome. It can require many tool calls.
Use gathering, crafting, construction, and usability prerequisites when the requested outcome requires them.
Do not limit goals to a fixed catalog.
Choose explicit, feasible acceptance conditions from the observation primitives.
Inventory names accept globs. Block names use exact Minecraft identifiers.
Use actual world coordinates. Do not invent a surveyed building site.
Condition positions use the schema's integer operands. Position distance is measured from floating feet coordinates; preserve the requested radius bounds.
For a house, the entry target belongs inside its clear interior. The exit target must lie outside its outer footprint, by the door approach.
Nearby-block summaries can include buried cells. They do not establish exposed ore.
Locate ore through exposed-cell find_block results and exact inspections with nonempty exposed_faces.
Do not probe buried ore coordinates from a nearby-block summary. Exact foundation inspections still describe ordinary construction support.
When ore coordinates remain unknown, plan an ordinary exposed search within the mining outcome instead of inventing a confirmed location.
Preserve the requested site and explicit distance bound when the body moves.
Exact cell reads establish existing construction. Retain correct blocks instead of repeating completed physical work.
The repaired body can dig grass and tall_grass. is_solid describes collision bounds; it does not restrict digging to solid cubes.
For preparation before block placement, allow observed replaceable vegetation when placement will remove it, or request ordinary plant digging.
Keep final required air cells strict after construction. Require fresh block evidence after vegetation clearance.
project_initial_observation is the original project baseline. observation is current state after retained world effects.
For an unchanged request, keep relative inventory targets based on the original baseline. Do not add the requested increment again after each failed attempt.
When the user changes instructions, use the new wording and current state to define the revised outcome.
Use a navigation survey leaf before construction when the current site is unsuitable.
Use previous_site_survey when supplied. Its retained cells describe the earlier surveyed site, not current completion.
Use latest_verification for failed acceptance. It identifies the original actor and verifier, exact operands, checks, and observed reads.
A region predicate measures blocks currently visible in that volume. It does not establish where earlier harvesting occurred.
Do not require harvested logs to remain as world blocks after gathering them into inventory.
Describe all usability requirements with observable criteria, including access, interior clearance, walls, and roof when requested.
Root criteria must cover the complete finished structure, rather than only a roof or one corner.
An installed Minecraft door occupies both its lower and upper cells. Both cells contain the door block, not air.
The region tool excludes hidden cells. Prefer exact block conditions for enclosed structures.
Acceptance records past attainment. Use assumptions for facts that must remain true.
Do not require gathered materials to remain in inventory after a dependent crafting task consumes them.
Use kind=accepted with node_id to cite independently verified earlier work in aggregate criteria.
For goals and stories, cite a verified descendant or declared prerequisite node. For leaves, cite a node whose leaves are explicitly declared prerequisites.
Declare each cited prerequisite directly in the leaf's depends_on. A dependency of another dependency does not authorize that certificate reference.
References remain valid when a prerequisite leaf becomes a story. Its original criteria stay on that story.
The selector verifies a completed story before dependent work can consume its materials.
For a material story, cite accepted gathering and crafting leaves rather than requiring consumed stock to remain.
For entry and exit, cite both accepted leaves in aggregate criteria. The body cannot finish at both positions simultaneously.
Keep fresh block criteria for the finished structure. Accepted references do not establish current inventory or current position.
Preserve stable IDs and all useful completed work during replanning.
Use gameplay_history for accumulated failed methods, partial quantities, search coverage, and active recovery.
For pm.gameplay-planning.v2, each methods row follows method_fields in order.
Its state_index selects complete preconditions in method_states.
Its tool_index selects the actual tool name in tool_names.
Its last row follows outcome_fields; merge additional_fields for changed result operands.
Resolve each journal source_index through source_paths.
Resolve each outcome kind_index through outcome_kinds.
Search entries inherit search_defaults; explicit entry values override them.
The row's tool and arguments also identify its last outcome unless additional_fields overrides them.
Historical inventory retains canonical names, counts, and available tool metadata. Display labels and empty fields remain in original journals.
Its last outcome uses that method's tool and arguments unless it records changed operands, such as a result limit.
Original journals retain the complete records.
rejected_proposal contains only changed nodes and removed IDs, with its original receipt reference.
An unchanged rejected condition uses from_node and condition_id to refer to its exact definition in previous_tree.
Keep every stable node ID. To split a leaf, make it a story under that same ID and add children beneath it.
Invalid raw output supplies an error excerpt rather than changed_nodes. Rebuild valid JSON from previous_tree and the requested change.
Active recovery can supersede optional scope when no recovery leaf is ready. Once a recovery leaf is ready, honor the supplied refinement_target.
Retain a ready recovery leaf while splitting the named optional target. Do not repeat accepted material work.
Use latest_plan_review to repair the last reviewed specification, including an earlier blocked review retained across explicit resume.
Recovery criteria describe a safe finished landing. Choose a surveyed dry alternative or include ordinary clearance of an observed removable obstruction.
Do not assume the current head cell is air when an exact inspection shows a placed workstation there.
Each search records only loaded, exposed cells in its dimension and coverage at its observation time.
Do not infer world-wide absence from an empty local search.
After two ineffective attempts, use a targeted diagnosis and a concrete changed method.
Replanning must add, revise, or defer a concrete leaf. Better wording outside the tree cannot release another attempt.
For a deferred leaf, set deferred=true and give a defer_reason. Its effects remain; it cannot pass final acceptance while deferred.
When recovery is active, add or revise a prerequisite-ready recovery specialist leaf before optional work.
Recovery needs full air, stable health, sufficient food, and exact dry landing geometry. A movement success alone cannot end it.
Keep recovery active through another method when the first escape fails.
Preserve original inventory targets and accepted work after partial progress.
Copy unchanged specifications exactly, including wording, criteria order, and assumptions.
Do not paraphrase accepted nodes. Change them only when the revised request or original evidence requires it.
When rejected_proposal is supplied, repair the stated contract error before submitting that proposal again.
When refinement names a target, change only that node and its descendants.
Preserve its original acceptance conditions exactly.
Split an oversized leaf into a story with prerequisite-ordered child outcomes.
Do not reuse Git rollback assumptions. All world effects remain.
When world facts are missing, return survey with explicit queries using the condition operands.
Use block queries for exact terrain layers or clearance cells. Inventory, position, alive, food, and region queries are also available.
Survey thresholds do not accept work. Use requested_world_survey as retained planning evidence.
Request world reads instead of asking the user to inspect terrain that MCP can read.
When an external service or a user preference is missing, return waiting with the specific question.
When the goal is impossible, return blocked with the actual reason.

original_proposal.summary: Repair recovery food criteria and make recovery a prerequisite for main work.

nodes.instruction: Build a small usable wooden house near the initial spawn and craft an iron pickaxe from self-mined iron.

criteria.description: Accept the house story.
Accept the iron mining and smelting story.
Require an iron pickaxe in the current inventory.
Accept the saved return route.

nodes.instruction: Recover from the low_supplies hazard.

criteria.description: Accept the final recovery leaf.

nodes.instruction: Escape the low_supplies hazard by moving to a dry landing with safe air and health.

criteria.description: The body is alive.

nodes.instruction: Finalize recovery by eating to restore food to a safe level.

criteria.description: The body has at least 7 food points.

nodes.instruction: Build a 5x5 wooden house at x=-5 to -1, z=4 to 8, y=118 to 121.

criteria.description: Accept the house construction story.
Accept the entry demonstration.
Accept the exit demonstration.

nodes.instruction: Clear the 5x5 site at x=-5 to -1, z=4 to 8, y=119 vegetation.

criteria.description: Verify the 3x3 interior cells at y=119 are air.

nodes.instruction: Build the house structure at the surveyed site.

criteria.description: Accept the interior verification leaf.

nodes.instruction: Place oak_planks floor at y=118 over all 25 cells.

criteria.description: Verify the complete 5x5 floor at y=118 is oak_planks.

nodes.instruction: Place oak_planks walls at y=119 and y=120 on all perimeter cells excluding the door.

criteria.description: Verify all perimeter wall cells (excluding door) are oak_planks at y=119 and y=120.

nodes.instruction: Place a wooden_door at x=-3,z=4 occupying both cells at y=119 and y=120.

criteria.description: Verify both door cells contain wooden_door blocks.

nodes.instruction: Place oak_slab roof at y=121 over all 25 cells.

criteria.description: Verify the complete 5x5 roof at y=121 is oak_slab.

nodes.instruction: Verify the 3x3 interior at x=-4 to -2, z=5 to 7 is air at y=119 and y=120.

criteria.description: Verify the 3x3 interior is air at y=119 and y=120.

nodes.instruction: Place workstations outside the house footprint.

criteria.description: Verify the entrance approach ground cell outside the door is walkable.

nodes.instruction: Demonstrate entry into the house by opening the door and positioning the body at the interior center x=-3,z=6,y=119.

criteria.description: The body must be at the interior center of the house with a radius of 0.7.

nodes.instruction: Demonstrate exit from the house by positioning the body at the entrance approach outside the house at x=-3,z=3,y=119.

criteria.description: The body must be at the entrance approach outside the house with a radius of 0.7.

nodes.instruction: Mine at least three raw iron from exposed iron ore, smelt it into iron ingots, and craft an iron pickaxe.

criteria.description: Accept the iron pickaxe crafting leaf.

nodes.instruction: Locate exposed iron ore and mine at least three raw iron into inventory.

criteria.description: Have at least 3 raw iron in inventory.

nodes.instruction: Use a furnace to smelt at least 3 raw iron into 3 iron ingots.

criteria.description: Have at least 3 iron ingots in inventory.

nodes.instruction: Craft an iron pickaxe using 3 iron ingots and 2 wooden sticks.

criteria.description: Have at least 1 iron pickaxe in inventory.

nodes.instruction: Test a return route from the house entrance to the initial spawn.

criteria.description: Accept the route test leaf.

nodes.instruction: Walk from the house entrance to the initial spawn area, verifying the path is walkable.

criteria.description: The body must return within 5 blocks of the initial spawn.
